sources.title: Current director biography
sources.findings: President and CEO since January 2024; director since February 2022. President/COO February 2022; merchandising EVP June 2016; real-estate SVP August 2015; Northwest SVP/general manager 2010.
sources.caution: Official June 2016 takes precedence over Seattle University July 2016 and EatingWell 2017. Current role is not founder or chairman.

sources.title: 18 October 2023: CEO succession
sources.findings: Vachris elected CEO effective January 1, 2024, succeeding Craig Jelinek; previously president and COO.
sources.caution: Announcement is not effective date. Jelinek continued advisory work through April 2024; not immediate departure from all roles.

sources.title: 12 February 2025: executive speaker biography
sources.findings: 1982 Price Club forklift role, 1993 merger with Costco, 1999 San Diego operations vice presidency, 2010 Northwest role.
sources.caution: Preview of February 19 event does not prove attendance. Merchandising July 2016 differs from official June 2016; use official date. Speaking invitation does not establish a degree.

sources.title: 8 August 2026: Ron Vachris interview
sources.findings: Recent substantive interview about his career and company culture.
sources.caution: Publication date, not known interview date. Merchandising date 2017 conflicts with primary biography and is not adopted. Courtesy Photo is not an open license.
